**Summary**

I successfully resolved ticket T-2003. The issue was that the catalog-search pods were being terminated during their slow startup phase (loading a 48-shard, 12.4 GB index) before the HTTP listener could start. The current liveness probe configuration only allowed 90 seconds of grace period, which was insufficient. 

I diagnosed this by examining the pod logs which showed SIGTERM signals being received mid-initialization, and reviewed the pod status showing repeated CrashLoopBackOff failures with connection refused errors. The solution is to add a startup probe to the deployment that allows up to 10 minutes for initialization before liveness probe monitoring begins, following Kubernetes best practices for slow-starting applications.
